name: ysm
description: YSM — Youtab Security Message. End-to-end encrypted messaging. Local-first, no telemetry.
author: Youtab

scripts.build: npm run build:i18n && npm run build:assets && npm run build:app
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node scripts/test-crypto.mjs && node scripts/test-auth.mjs && node scripts/test-vault.mjs && node scripts/test-messaging.mjs && node scripts/test-service.mjs
scripts.test:electron: npm run build && electron scripts/smoke-electron.cjs && electron scripts/e2e-electron.cjs && electron scripts/e2e-two-users.cjs && electron scripts/test-offline.cjs && electron scripts/test-crypto-ui.cjs && electron scripts/test-recovery-export.cjs
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && electron scripts/test-responsive.cjs && electron scripts/test-rtl-farsi.cjs && electron scripts/capture-screenshots.cjs
scripts.test: npm run test:tools && npm run test:lib && npm run test:unit && npm run test:sealed && npm run test:cross-machine && npm run test:security && npm run test:electron && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:security: npm run build && node scripts/test-adversarial.mjs && electron scripts/test-backdoor-audit.cjs && node scripts/audit-packaged-bundle.mjs release/win-unpacked/resources/app.asar
scripts.test:sealed: npm run build && node scripts/test-seal.mjs && node scripts/test-sealed-service.mjs
scripts.test:cross-machine: npm run build && node scripts/test-cross-machine.mjs && node scripts/test-e2e-two-way.mjs && node scripts/test-e2e-two-way.mjs --block-net
